Palace SaloonBack to the Future Part IIIHill Valley, 1885. Bring an appetite.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersFestival corn on the cobCharred corn rolled in butter, salt and smoked paprikaHow to make it4 corn cobs60g butter1 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp sea salt flakesBoil the corn in salted water.Char on a hot grill, turning, until blackened in spots.Melt the butter, roll each cob in it and sprinkle with flaky salt and smoked paprika.Clara's apple slicesCrisp apple slices with honey cinnamon yoghurt to dipHow to make it3 crisp apples1 lemon250g Greek yoghurt2 tbsp honey1/2 tsp ground cinnamonSlice the apples and toss in the lemon juice so they stay white.Whip the yoghurt with the honey and cinnamon.Fan the apples around a bowl of the yoghurt for dipping.MainsDoc's blacksmith shop stewBeef braised in dark aleHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions3 carrots375ml dark ale500ml beef stock1 crusty loaf2 tbsp vegetable oilsalt and pepper, to tasteHeat the oven to 150°C. Season the beef and brown in the oil in batches in a heavy ovenproof pot.Soften the sliced onions and chopped carrots in the same pot.Return the beef, add the ale and stock and bring to a simmer.Cover and braise in the oven until the beef falls apart.Serve with the crusty bread for mopping up.Hill Valley festival smoked brisketBrisket and beans at the 1885 festivalHow to make itAs written, serves 4Salt and pepper brisket smoked low and slow until it wobbles, sliced thick with molasses baked beans and buttery pan cornbread.Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper.Smoke or roast at 120°C for about 10 hours until it reaches 95°C inside, wrapping in baking paper at 70°C.Rest 1 hour, then slice.Simmer 2 drained tins cannellini beans with 1 diced onion, 3 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard and 250ml stock for 45 minutes.Bake cornbread mix in a buttered hot pan at 200°C for 20 minutes.SweetsClara's festival apple pieDouble crust apple pie with cinnamon and nutmegHow to make it1kg Granny Smith apples120g caster sugar, for the filling1 tsp ground cinnamon1/4 tsp nutmeg2 tbsp plain flour4 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry1 egg1 tbsp caster sugar, for sprinklingHeat the oven to 190°C. Peel, core and slice the apples and toss with the filling sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and flour.Line a pie dish with two pastry sheets and fill with the apples.Cover with the other two sheets, seal and trim the edges, cut a few steam vents.Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with the remaining caster sugar.Bake until deep golden and the juices bubble. Rest before slicing.DrinksWake-up juiceFiery lemon, ginger and chilli topped with ginger beerHow to make it3 lemons1 knob ginger (5 cm), grated2 tbsp honey1 small red chilli, chopped600ml ginger beer2 cups iceJuice the lemons and blitz with the ginger, honey and chilli, then strain.Fill four glasses with ice and divide the juice between them.Top each with very cold ginger beer.
